summary: A local modified installer is prepared and locally checked. It omits one automatic listing/self-test launch. Installation, registration, listing and TUI completion have not been demonstrated by this attempt.
method: Root review of exact retained source, candidate provenance and nine isolated local tests; separate independent static review retained privately. No full installer was imported or run.

sources.name: Retained public installer
sources.limitation: URL is mutable. Findings refer to retained bytes with this digest, not a future download.

sources.name: Local modified candidate
sources.limitation: Not an upstream release. Only the direct helper-launch block changed; file retained locally with mode 0600.

sources.name: Retained self-test helper
sources.limitation: Static source, not a listing or self-test execution.

sources.name: Retained updater script
sources.limitation: Downstream executable payloads are not all retained or pinned.

sources.name: TUI source checkout
sources.limitation: Reviewed working file matches the Git object. Correspondence to the downloaded TUI binary is UNVALIDATED.

findings.status_scope: Exact local transformation and isolated helper-launch simulation only
findings.finding: Original lines 1961-1969 call start_self_test.sh. The candidate replaces only that block with an omission log at lines 1961-1965. The original extracted block launches the fake helper with a generated GPU price of 24 for four GPUs; the candidate extracted block does not launch it.
findings.limits: No installer or helper ran on a host. This does not prove the page's initialization timing, upstream TUI/standard route, daemon behavior or suppression of all possible listing paths.
findings.next_action: Retain a separate live installation and publication-control result before promoting an installation or listing claim.

findings.status_scope: Compatibility expectation for the proposed intentional-skip route against reviewed local TUI source; not a client-page claim adjudication
findings.finding: The reviewed TUI expects a fresh self-test banner. Its default wait is five minutes; absent a fresh banner it sets failed and exit code -1. Intentional omission is not represented as a separate completion state in this inspected flow.
findings.limits: Static source finding. The identity check's printed timeout value is a source-read annotation, not a measured runtime timeout. No binary was launched and no five-minute UI run was performed.
findings.next_action: Choose a direct modified-installer run and label it as that route, or implement and verify an explicit TUI skip state. Do not mark the stock TUI workflow verified from this variant.

findings.status_scope: Read-only observations at the captured timestamp only
findings.finding: At 19:34:33 UTC the approved new host reported four H100 PCIe GPUs, an active XFS Docker mount with prjquota, and a persistent XFS Docker mount entry with pquota. Docker and Vast services were not installed.
findings.limits: The new fstab observation resolves the older missing-fstab observation gap. It does not establish quota enforcement, container execution, successful installation, persistent state after reboot or freedom from later storage changes.
findings.next_action: Recheck the exact target, current mount and persistent entry immediately before a bounded installation; retain post-install service/container/quota observations separately.

findings.status_scope: No-storage-change guarantee for a future installation
findings.finding: --no-partitioning alone does not prevent loop-file formatting, fstab updates or Docker-data migration if the reusable mount branch is not taken. The observed active and persistent mount support that branch, but the installer has not executed it.
findings.limits: Source plus point-in-time preflight, not a runtime branch observation. No formatting, mount operation or storage mutation was performed.
findings.next_action: Freeze non-destructive arguments and guard the reuse conditions; stop if they drift. Do not select a new partition or loopback fallback.

findings.status_scope: Remaining live installation and no-reboot behavior
findings.finding: The candidate retains registration, package/service changes, updater downloads, daemon start, NVML/NCCL container diagnostics and send_mach_info.py --speedtest. Removing the final helper does not remove these effects. The inspected retained files do not contain a direct reboot command, but the full downloaded execution chain is not proven reboot-free.
findings.limits: Not an offline or workload-free installer. Unretained downstream executable bytes are an evidence gap, not invented Product/Legal authority and not by themselves a universal BLOCKED status.
findings.next_action: Before live execution, freeze the route and arguments, retain resolved dependency identities, and set explicit stop/no-reboot/publication controls for the remaining install and diagnostic effects. Resolve any unavailable code or required risk decision by name.

findings.responsible_role: Crypto Labs team-host setup-key administrator / authorized operator
findings.missing_prerequisite: A fresh one-hour team-host installation setup key, supplied through a specific approved Keychain service and account
findings.finding: No fresh setup-key entry/account has been supplied for this attempt. The SSH key, regular Host API key and client API key are not substitutes.
findings.limits: No key was fetched or tested. The old key pasted into chat will not be reused or retained in public evidence.
findings.next_action: Create and securely save a fresh setup key, then supply only its Keychain service/entry and account.

findings.status_scope: Eventual offer settings and marketplace publication
findings.finding: User-approved future terms are USD 3/GPU-hour on-demand, USD 0.30/GPU-hour minimum bid, USD 0.50/GB-month storage, and expiry no later than September 15, 2026. This patch neither applies nor verifies those settings.
findings.limits: The helper's three-hour expiry was within the user's ceiling. Its generated price and omitted bid/storage controls were the observed mismatch; no marketplace listing was changed in this attempt.
findings.next_action: After successful bounded installation and a readiness decision, list only the intended machine with all approved fields explicit and retain independent API/UI readback including the absolute expiry.

overall_limits: These are supplemental source/preparation observations, not a replacement for the client-facing statement or its existing status.
No canonical claim status changed. Prior attempts and current runtime/source-owner registers remain authoritative for unresolved claims.
No Product, Finance, Legal confirmation, human acceptance, live install, listing, paid rental, explicit self-test or reboot was recorded.
